hero.heading: External Crisis Support
hero.subtitle: A comprehensive list of free, confidential crisis hotlines and support services available in major countries. If you are in immediate danger of self-harm or require urgent medical assistance, please contact your local national first responders or visit your local hospital.

lines.name: Samaritans
lines.notes: Free, confidential emotional support for anyone in distress.

lines.name: Shout Crisis Text Line
lines.notes: Free, confidential text support for immediate mental help.

lines.name: NHS Mental Health Services
lines.notes: Non-urgent support and guidance for clinical routing.

lines.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
lines.notes: Free, confidential support for individuals in suicidal crisis or emotional distress.

lines.name: Crisis Text Line
lines.notes: Free connection to a crisis counselor via SMS.

lines.name: The Trevor Project (LGBTQ+)
lines.notes: Specialized support for LGBTQ young people.

lines.name: Lifeline
lines.notes: National charity providing all Australians access to crisis support.

lines.name: Beyond Blue
lines.notes: Support and information on anxiety, depression, and suicide prevention.

lines.name: 1737, Need to Talk?
lines.notes: Free, confidential service connecting you to a trained counselor.

lines.name: Lifeline Aotearoa
lines.notes: Confidential support services delivered by qualified staff and volunteers.

international.heading: Other Countries & Regions
international.body: If your country is not listed above, Befrienders Worldwide helps you search for local helpline numbers and support organizations in over 40 countries.
